items.name: activity-bar-chart
items.title: Activity Bar Chart
items.description: shadcn chart preset (recharts) for fa-auth per-model added/updated activity.

items.name: dashboard-overview
items.title: Account Dashboard Overview
items.description: fa-auth activity dashboard (stat cards + chart) driven by the package's useDashboard hook. Requires @mano8/astro-auth-m8 installed.

items.name: account-dashboard
items.title: Account Dashboard
items.description: fa-auth account view whose first/landing tab is the activity dashboard; secondary tabs are wired by the consumer. Requires @mano8/astro-auth-m8 installed.

items.name: profile-panel
items.title: Account Profile Panel
items.description: fa-auth profile editor (metadata + password rotation) driven by the package's useAuth + useProfile hooks. Requires @mano8/astro-auth-m8 installed.

items.name: sessions-panel
items.title: Account Sessions Panel
items.description: fa-auth session details + activity summaries with superuser-only session revocation, driven by the package's useSessions + useDashboard hooks. Requires @mano8/astro-auth-m8 installed.

items.name: account-crud
items.title: Account CRUD Helpers
items.description: Shared skin helpers for the fa-auth account panels: a client-side controller for the canonical astro-ui-m8 data-table, a popup form dialog, a delete-confirmation alert, the fixed row-actions cell, and the bottom-right toast host.

items.name: api-keys-panel
items.title: Account API Keys Panel
items.description: fa-auth API token mint/revoke panel on the canonical data-table (page selector, orderable columns, column visibility), with popup create form, alert-dialog revoke confirm, and bottom-right toasts. Driven by the package's useApiKeys hook. Requires @mano8/astro-auth-m8 installed.

items.name: admin-users-panel
items.title: Admin Users Panel
items.description: fa-auth superuser-only user management on the canonical data-table (page selector, orderable columns, column visibility), with popup create/edit forms, alert-dialog delete confirm, and bottom-right toasts. Gated by the package's RequireRole and driven by useUsers. Requires @mano8/astro-auth-m8 installed.
